mapper.select: SELECT a.rid_long,a.hid,h.baseName as hospitalname,a.deptname,a.doctorname,specialties,a.doctor_url,a.profileimgurl,a.data_version_id, b.jsondata as info FROM doctor_basic a LEFT JOIN doctor_career b ON a.rid = b.rid LEFT JOIN hospital h ON a.hid = h.hid WHERE a.hid = #{search_hid} and is_active = 2 and a.data_version_id = #{search_data_version_id} and a.doctor_id is null ORDER BY a.deptname , a.doctorname LIMIT 120 OFFSET 0

SELECT a.rid_long,a.hid,h.baseName as hospitalname,a.deptname,a.doctorname,specialties,a.doctor_url,a.profileimgurl,a.data_version_id, b.jsondata as info FROM doctor_basic a LEFT JOIN doctor_career b ON a.rid = b.rid LEFT JOIN hospital h ON a.hid = h.hid WHERE a.rid_long = #{search_rid_long}

SELECT a.rid_long,a.hid,h.baseName as hospitalname,a.deptname,a.doctorname,specialties,a.doctor_url,a.profileimgurl,a.data_version_id, b.jsondata as info FROM doctor_basic a LEFT JOIN doctor_career b ON a.rid = b.rid LEFT JOIN hospital h ON a.hid = h.hid WHERE a.doctorname LIKE CONCAT(#{search_doctorname}, '%') and a.rid_long not in ( #{pass_rid_long} ) and a.data_version_id in ( 1,2 ) and a.rid not in ( SELECT rid FROM doctor_basic_logs ) ORDER BY a.deptname , a.doctorname
